faq_heading: South Surrey coach houses: your questions answered

faq.q: Do Surrey’s coach house rules apply in White Rock?
faq.a: No. White Rock is its own city. Surrey’s limits, 35 to 75 square metres and lane access on smaller lots, apply to South Surrey, Crescent Beach and Ocean Park, Elgin Chantrell, Grandview and the other Surrey neighbourhoods.

faq.q: Can I build a coach house in Crescent Beach?
faq.a: Possibly, but the lot is in a floodplain. The flood construction level is 3.30 metres above Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, a floodplain build needs a geotechnical engineer, and building below that level needs a Development Variance Permit.

faq.q: How much do South Surrey houses with a coach house cost?
faq.a: About 4% below the all-house median. 12 South Surrey houses marked as a coach or laneway house sold from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026 at a median of $1,640,000, against $1,700,000 for all South Surrey detached houses. The flag is entered by the listing agent, so the true number is higher. With only 12 sales the gap is a rough sign, not a trend. The median for all South Surrey detached houses was $1,716,500 in the year to October 22, 2026, with the middle half between $1,421,000 and $2,125,000.

faq.q: Which South Surrey area has the biggest lots?
faq.a: Elgin Chantrell, with a median lot of 13,989 sq ft. Grandview and Pacific Douglas are the smallest at 4,014 sq ft and 3,787 sq ft.

faq.q: How long do South Surrey houses take to sell?
faq.a: 32 days at a median, and houses closed at 95.7% of list price. 6% sold over the list price.

faq.q: Can a South Surrey duplex have a suite as well?
faq.a: Yes, one suite per half of a duplex, up to 40% of that unit’s habitable floor area. I list them on the South Surrey duplexes with suites page.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Coach house figures come from the Carriage/Coach House and Laneway House style flags in Paragon closed and pending sales, which the listing agent fills in, so the counts are small and will miss some. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists detached houses for sale in South Surrey with a coach house on the lot. It covers Crescent Beach and Ocean Park, Elgin Chantrell, Grandview, King George Corridor, Morgan Creek, Pacific Douglas, Sunnyside Park and Hazelmere. White Rock is a separate city with its own bylaws and is not part of this search.

Paragon marks 12 of the 502 South Surrey detached houses that sold from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026 as a coach house or laneway house. They sold at a median of $1,640,000, 4% below the $1,700,000 median for all South Surrey houses in the same months. The flag is typed in by the listing agent, so treat the count as a floor and not a census. With only 12 sales the price gap is a rough sign, not a trend. South Surrey as a whole is the market around it: its median is $1,716,500 in the year to October 22, 2026, which is $331,500 above the City of Surrey median.
Surrey’s rules, as they apply in South Surrey

South Surrey is part of the City of Surrey, so one set of coach house rules covers it. A coach house or garden suite is between 35 and 75 square metres. Any residential zone that allows a detached house, a duplex or a houseplex also allows one. Smaller R3 to R6 lots need lane access for a coach house, and the lot has to carry one extra parking space.

Lots zoned RA, R2, R2-O or R3 get more room: up to 120 square metres where the existing house is below its maximum floor area ratio. Elgin Chantrell has the largest lots in South Surrey, with a median house lot of 13,989 sq ft, so check each lot’s zone before assuming its limit.
The one-suite-per-unit rule still applies. A secondary suite is allowed in the main house, capped at 40% of its habitable floor area, and not inside the coach house.
Crescent Beach is its own case

Crescent Beach has a flood construction level of 3.30 metres above Geodetic Survey of Canada datum. Building below it needs a Development Variance Permit, floodplain construction calls for a geotechnical engineer, and most Crescent Beach properties cannot connect to the City storm sewer. A second home on a Crescent Beach lot is a different project from one in Sunnyside Park.
South Surrey neighbourhoods: where lots are small and where they are large

The median lot of a house that sold in Grandview was 4,014 sq ft and in Pacific Douglas 3,787 sq ft, both newer neighbourhoods (median built 2018 and 2013). Elgin Chantrell sits at the other end with 13,989 sq ft and a $2,280,000 median price, the highest of any South Surrey neighbourhood. Crescent Beach and Ocean Park had the most sales, 107, at $1,745,000.

What to ask on a South Surrey listing

items.t: Which city is the lot in? A White Rock address follows White Rock’s bylaws, not Surrey’s.
Does the coach house have its own permit and final inspection, and is it the size the listing says?
For Crescent Beach, ask for the flood construction level and the geotechnical report on the house.
If the lot is an acreage, ask whether it is inside the Agricultural Land Reserve.
